#7. 一括処理関数：SusIとかSupIとかをまとめて計算
#SusI計算関数に引数tc_min_timeを足したこと(ver4.10)を反映
```{r}
# ===================================================================
# Batch Processing Function (Version 2.6)
# Changes from v2.5:
# - Added vi_min_time parameter (default = 1.0), passed to
#   calculate_virulence_index_advanced_v20 and plot_vi_three_levels.
#   Set vi_min_time = 2.0 for ΦWec430 (prolonged lag phase).
# ===================================================================
process_phage_data_v20 <- function(file_path,
                                   phage_name,
                                   fig_label = phage_name,
                                   calculation_method = "biological_replicates",
                                   time_limit_hours = NULL,
                                   output_file = "results.txt",
                                   create_plots = TRUE,
                                   create_od_curves = TRUE,
                                   od_curve_method = "biological_replicates",
                                   # Plotting options
                                   supi_ylim = NULL,
                                   susi_ylim = NULL,
                                   vi_ylim = NULL,
                                   ti_tc_ylim = NULL,
                                   r_sheet = "R",
                                   name_sheet = "name",
                                   control_sample = "Ct",
                                   # Common tc parameter
                                   tc_slope_threshold = 0.03,
                                   tc_min_time = 1.0,
                                   # VI-specific lag phase parameter
                                   vi_min_time = 1.0,
                                   # SusI-specific (t0/ti detection)
                                   t0_detection = "auto",
                                   t0_min_time = 0.25,
                                   t0_sustainability = 5.0,
                                   n_forward_points_t0 = 5,
                                   threshold_percentage_t0 = 0.6,
                                   n_forward_points_ti = 5,
                                   threshold_percentage_ti = 0.6,
                                   min_lysis_time = 2.0,
                                   min_increase_threshold = 0.05,
                                   # ===================================================
                                   # Font size options (added v11, 2026/07/29)
                                   # Applied to all 5 figures generated by this function
                                   # (growth curve, SusI/SupI/VI/ti-tc three-level plots).
                                   # Defaults match the previous hardcoded sizes, so
                                   # nothing changes unless you override them below.
                                   # ===================================================
                                   title_size = 14,              # Plot title (all figures)
                                   subtitle_size = 10,           # Subtitle (SusI/SupI/VI/ti-tc)
                                   axis_title_size = 12,         # Axis titles (all figures)
                                   axis_text_size = 10,          # Axis tick labels (all figures)
                                   legend_text_size = 10,        # Legend item labels (all figures)
                                   legend_title_size = 11,       # Legend title (all figures)
                                   reference_label_size = 3,     # "MV50 threshold" / "ti = tc" labels
                                   od_tc_label_size = 3.5,       # "tc = ..." label on growth curve
                                   od_timepoint_label_size = 2.8,# "t0"/"ti" labels on growth curve
                                   # ===================================================
                                   # Show/hide options (added v11, 2026/07/31)
                                   # Applied to all 5 figures generated by this function.
                                   # ===================================================
                                   show_legend = TRUE,           # set FALSE to hide legend
                                   show_title  = TRUE,           # set FALSE to hide plot title
                                   ...) {
  
  cat(sprintf("\n========================================\n"))
  cat(sprintf("Processing: %s (%s)\n", fig_label, calculation_method))
  cat(sprintf("========================================\n"))
  if (tc_min_time != 1.0) {
    cat(sprintf("tc search start: %.2f hours (tc_min_time)\n", tc_min_time))
  }
  if (vi_min_time != 1.0) {
    cat(sprintf("VI integration limit search start: %.2f hours (vi_min_time)\n", vi_min_time))
  }
  
  # ===================================================================
  # Calculate VI
  # ===================================================================
  cat("\n[1/3] Calculating VI...\n")
  vi_results <- calculate_virulence_index_advanced_v20(
    file_path          = file_path,
    r_sheet            = r_sheet,
    name_sheet         = name_sheet,
    control_sample     = control_sample,
    calculation_method = calculation_method,
    time_limit_hours   = "auto",
    vi_min_time        = vi_min_time,
    slope_threshold    = tc_slope_threshold
  )
  
  # ===================================================================
  # Calculate SusI
  # ===================================================================
  cat("\n[2/3] Calculating SusI...\n")
  susi_results <- calculate_lysis_persistence_index_v21(
    file_path               = file_path,
    r_sheet                 = r_sheet,
    name_sheet              = name_sheet,
    control_sample          = control_sample,
    calculation_method      = calculation_method,
    time_limit_hours        = time_limit_hours,
    t0_detection            = t0_detection,
    t0_min_time             = t0_min_time,
    t0_sustainability       = t0_sustainability,
    n_forward_points_t0     = n_forward_points_t0,
    threshold_percentage_t0 = threshold_percentage_t0,
    slope_threshold_tc      = tc_slope_threshold,
    tc_min_time             = tc_min_time,
    n_forward_points_ti     = n_forward_points_ti,
    threshold_percentage_ti = threshold_percentage_ti,
    min_lysis_time          = min_lysis_time,
    min_increase_threshold  = min_increase_threshold
  )
  
  # ===================================================================
  # Calculate SupI
  # ===================================================================
  cat("\n[3/3] Calculating SupI...\n")
  supi_results <- calculate_suppression_index_v20(
    file_path          = file_path,
    r_sheet            = r_sheet,
    name_sheet         = name_sheet,
    control_sample     = control_sample,
    calculation_method = calculation_method,
    time_limit_hours   = time_limit_hours
  )
  
  # ===================================================================
  # Save results
  # ===================================================================
  if (calculation_method %in% c("biological_replicates", "overall_mean")) {
    cat("\nSaving results to file...\n")
    save_results_to_file(
      vi_results   = vi_results,
      susi_results = susi_results,
      supi_results = supi_results,
      fig_label    = paste0(fig_label, "_", calculation_method),
      output_file  = output_file
    )
  } else {
    cat("\nNote: individual_wells method does not generate summary file.\n")
    cat("      Use biological_replicates or overall_mean for summary statistics.\n")
  }
  
  # ===================================================================
  # Create 3-level plots (only for individual_wells method)
  # ===================================================================
  if (create_plots && calculation_method == "individual_wells") {
    cat("\nCreating three-level plots...\n")
    
    cat("  - SusI three-level plot\n")
    plot_susi_three_levels(
      file_path               = file_path,
      r_sheet                 = r_sheet,
      name_sheet              = name_sheet,
      phage_name              = fig_label,
      control_sample          = control_sample,
      time_limit_hours        = time_limit_hours,
      ylim_range              = susi_ylim,
      t0_detection            = t0_detection,
      t0_min_time             = t0_min_time,
      t0_sustainability       = t0_sustainability,
      n_forward_points_t0     = n_forward_points_t0,
      threshold_percentage_t0 = threshold_percentage_t0,
      slope_threshold_tc      = tc_slope_threshold,
      tc_min_time             = tc_min_time,
      n_forward_points_ti     = n_forward_points_ti,
      threshold_percentage_ti = threshold_percentage_ti,
      min_lysis_time          = min_lysis_time,
      min_increase_threshold  = min_increase_threshold,
      title_size              = title_size,
      subtitle_size           = subtitle_size,
      axis_title_size         = axis_title_size,
      axis_text_size          = axis_text_size,
      legend_text_size        = legend_text_size,
      legend_title_size       = legend_title_size,
      show_legend              = show_legend,
      show_title               = show_title
    )
    
    cat("  - SupI three-level plot\n")
    plot_supi_three_levels(
      file_path        = file_path,
      r_sheet          = r_sheet,
      name_sheet       = name_sheet,
      phage_name       = fig_label,
      time_limit_hours = time_limit_hours,
      control_sample   = control_sample,
      ylim_range       = supi_ylim,
      title_size       = title_size,
      subtitle_size    = subtitle_size,
      axis_title_size  = axis_title_size,
      axis_text_size   = axis_text_size,
      legend_text_size = legend_text_size,
      legend_title_size = legend_title_size,
      show_legend      = show_legend,
      show_title       = show_title
    )
    
    cat("  - VI three-level plot\n")
    plot_vi_three_levels(
      file_path        = file_path,
      r_sheet          = r_sheet,
      name_sheet       = name_sheet,
      phage_name       = fig_label,
      time_limit_hours = "auto",
      vi_min_time      = vi_min_time,
      control_sample   = control_sample,
      slope_threshold  = tc_slope_threshold,
      ylim_range       = vi_ylim,
      title_size       = title_size,
      subtitle_size    = subtitle_size,
      axis_title_size  = axis_title_size,
      axis_text_size   = axis_text_size,
      legend_text_size = legend_text_size,
      legend_title_size = legend_title_size,
      reference_label_size = reference_label_size,
      show_legend      = show_legend,
      show_title       = show_title
    )
    
    cat("  - ti/tc three-level plot\n")
    plot_ti_tc_three_levels(
      file_path               = file_path,
      r_sheet                 = r_sheet,
      name_sheet              = name_sheet,
      phage_name              = fig_label,
      control_sample          = control_sample,
      time_limit_hours        = time_limit_hours,
      ylim_range              = ti_tc_ylim,
      t0_detection            = t0_detection,
      t0_min_time             = t0_min_time,
      t0_sustainability       = t0_sustainability,
      n_forward_points_t0     = n_forward_points_t0,
      threshold_percentage_t0 = threshold_percentage_t0,
      slope_threshold_tc      = tc_slope_threshold,
      tc_min_time             = tc_min_time,
      n_forward_points_ti     = n_forward_points_ti,
      threshold_percentage_ti = threshold_percentage_ti,
      min_lysis_time          = min_lysis_time,
      min_increase_threshold  = min_increase_threshold,
      title_size              = title_size,
      subtitle_size           = subtitle_size,
      axis_title_size         = axis_title_size,
      axis_text_size          = axis_text_size,
      legend_text_size        = legend_text_size,
      legend_title_size       = legend_title_size,
      reference_label_size    = reference_label_size,
      show_legend              = show_legend,
      show_title               = show_title
    )
    
  } else if (create_plots) {
    cat("\n  Note: Three-level plots only available for 'individual_wells' method\n")
  }
  
  # ===================================================================
  # Create OD curves
  # ===================================================================
  if (create_od_curves) {
    cat("\nCreating OD growth curves...\n")
    
    if (od_curve_method != calculation_method) {
      cat(sprintf("  Calculating ti/tc using %s method for OD curves...\n",
                  od_curve_method))
      susi_for_od <- calculate_lysis_persistence_index_v21(
        file_path               = file_path,
        r_sheet                 = r_sheet,
        name_sheet              = name_sheet,
        control_sample          = control_sample,
        calculation_method      = od_curve_method,
        time_limit_hours        = time_limit_hours,
        t0_detection            = t0_detection,
        t0_min_time             = t0_min_time,
        t0_sustainability       = t0_sustainability,
        n_forward_points_t0     = n_forward_points_t0,
        threshold_percentage_t0 = threshold_percentage_t0,
        slope_threshold_tc      = tc_slope_threshold,
        tc_min_time             = tc_min_time,
        n_forward_points_ti     = n_forward_points_ti,
        threshold_percentage_ti = threshold_percentage_ti,
        min_lysis_time          = min_lysis_time,
        min_increase_threshold  = min_increase_threshold
      )
    } else {
      susi_for_od <- susi_results
    }
    
    tryCatch({
      plot_growth_curves_with_timepoints(
        results          = susi_for_od,
        phage_name       = fig_label,
        show_legend      = show_legend,
        show_title       = show_title,
        time_limit_hours = time_limit_hours,
        title_size            = title_size,
        axis_title_size       = axis_title_size,
        axis_text_size        = axis_text_size,
        legend_text_size      = legend_text_size,
        legend_title_size     = legend_title_size,
        tc_label_size         = od_tc_label_size,
        timepoint_label_size  = od_timepoint_label_size
      )
      cat("  OD curves plotted successfully\n")
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("  Error plotting OD curves:", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("\n========================================\n"))
  cat(sprintf("Complete: %s\n", fig_label))
  cat(sprintf("========================================\n\n"))
  
  return(invisible(list(
    vi_results   = vi_results,
    susi_results = susi_results,
    supi_results = supi_results
  )))
}
```

# Helper function + quick start example
```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: build a file path from a phage name
#   build_file_path("T1") -> "data/T1_rawdata.xlsx"
# Adjust base_dir / suffix to match your own folder and naming convention.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
build_file_path <- function(phage_name, strain,
                            base_dir = "data",
                            suffix = "_rawdata.xlsx") {
  file.path(base_dir, strain, paste0(phage_name, suffix))
}
# build_file_path("T6", "MG1655") -> "data/MG1655/T6_rawdata.xlsx"
```

## Quick start: process_phage_data_v20()

Runs the full SusI / SupI / VI / ti-tc analysis (and, by default, all five
figures) for one phage, using the sample data included in `data/`.

```{r}
phage_name <- "T1"
file_path  <- build_file_path(phage_name)   # "data/T1_rawdata.xlsx"

# Loop over the three calculation methods used in the paper.
# Plots and OD curves are only generated once each, to avoid duplicate output.
for (method in c("biological_replicates", "individual_wells", "overall_mean")) {
  results <- process_phage_data_v20(
    file_path           = file_path,
    phage_name           = phage_name,
    calculation_method   = method,
    tc_min_time          = 1.0,   # raise (e.g. 2.0) for a long flat lag phase - see note above
    n_forward_points_t0  = 10,
    n_forward_points_ti  = 7,
    threshold_percentage_t0 = 0.6,
    threshold_percentage_ti = 0.6,
    min_increase_threshold  = 0.008,
    t0_sustainability    = 20,
    time_limit_hours     = 24,
    output_file          = paste0(phage_name, "_results.txt"),
    create_plots         = (method == "individual_wells"),
    create_od_curves     = (method == "biological_replicates")
  )
}
```

## Batch example: every phage in data/, all three methods, no plots

Useful for generating summary numbers across many files without opening a
plot window for each one.

```{r}
phages     <- c("T1")   # add one entry per rawdata file in data/
output_dir <- "output"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (phage in phages) {
  cat(sprintf("\n========== %s ==========\n", phage))
  file_path <- build_file_path(phage)

  if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
    cat("File not found - skipping\n")
    next
  }

  for (method in c("biological_replicates", "individual_wells", "overall_mean")) {
    cat(sprintf("  Method: %s ... ", method))
    tryCatch({
      process_phage_data_v20(
        file_path           = file_path,
        phage_name           = phage,
        calculation_method   = method,
        n_forward_points_t0  = 10,
        n_forward_points_ti  = 7,
        threshold_percentage_t0 = 0.6,
        threshold_percentage_ti = 0.6,
        min_increase_threshold  = 0.008,
        t0_sustainability    = 20,
        time_limit_hours     = 24,
        output_file          = file.path(output_dir, paste0(phage, "_results.txt")),
        create_plots         = FALSE,
        create_od_curves     = FALSE
      )
      cat("done\n")
    }, error = function(e) cat(sprintf("ERROR: %s\n", e$message)))
  }
}
```

# diagnose_all_mois_enhanced(): per-well t0/ti detection diagnostics for every
# MOI condition in a file, with success/failure classification, an Excel
# report, and diagnostic plots. Useful for tuning the detection thresholds
# above before committing to a final parameter set.
```{r DEF}
# ===================================================================
# Batch Diagnostic Function: All MOIs (Enhanced)
# Version 1.2 - Added tc_min_time parameter
#
# Changes from v1.1:
# - Added tc_min_time parameter (default = 0), passed to
#   calculate_lysis_persistence_index_v21
# - tc_min_time is also recorded in the Parameters Excel sheet
# ===================================================================
diagnose_all_mois_enhanced <- function(file_path,
                                       phage_name = "Phage",
                                       output_excel = NULL,
                                       r_sheet = "R",
                                       name_sheet = "name",
                                       control_sample = "Ct",
                                       time_limit_hours = NULL,
                                       t0_detection = "auto",
                                       t0_min_time = 0.25,
                                       t0_sustainability = 5.0,
                                       n_forward_points_t0 = 5,
                                       threshold_percentage_t0 = 0.6,
                                       slope_threshold_tc = 0.03,
                                       tc_min_time = 1.0,
                                       n_forward_points_ti = 5,
                                       threshold_percentage_ti = 0.6,
                                       min_lysis_time = 2.0,
                                       min_increase_threshold = 0.05,
                                       plot_od_curves = TRUE,
                                       show_timepoint_lines = TRUE,
                                       # Font size options (added v11-5, 2026/08/xx)
                                       # Defaults match the previous hardcoded/implicit sizes.
                                       title_size = 14,
                                       subtitle_size = 10,
                                       axis_title_size = 12,
                                       axis_text_size = 10,
                                       legend_text_size = 10,
                                       legend_title_size = 11,
                                       strip_text_size = 12,
                                       tc_label_size = 3.5,
                                       timepoint_label_size = 3,
                                       # Show/hide options
                                       show_legend = TRUE,
                                       show_title = TRUE) {
  
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(openxlsx)
  
  cat("\n=== BATCH DIAGNOSTIC: ALL MOIs ===\n")
  cat(sprintf("Phage: %s\n", phage_name))
  cat(sprintf("Parameters:\n"))
  cat(sprintf("  t0: threshold_percentage=%.1f%%, n_forward=%d, min_time=%.2fh, sustainability=%.1fh\n",
              threshold_percentage_t0 * 100, n_forward_points_t0,
              t0_min_time, t0_sustainability))
  cat(sprintf("  ti: threshold_percentage=%.1f%%, n_forward=%d, min_increase=%.3f\n",
              threshold_percentage_ti * 100, n_forward_points_ti,
              min_increase_threshold))
  if (tc_min_time > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("  tc: search start = %.2f hours (tc_min_time)\n", tc_min_time))
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  if (is.null(output_excel)) {
    output_excel <- paste0(phage_name, "_diagnosis.xlsx")
  }
  
  # ===================================================================
  # STEP 1: Run calculation (individual_wells)
  # ===================================================================
  cat("Calculating with individual_wells method...\n")
  
  susi_results <- calculate_lysis_persistence_index_v21(
    file_path               = file_path,
    r_sheet                 = r_sheet,
    name_sheet              = name_sheet,
    control_sample          = control_sample,
    calculation_method      = "individual_wells",
    time_limit_hours        = time_limit_hours,
    t0_detection            = t0_detection,
    t0_min_time             = t0_min_time,
    t0_sustainability       = t0_sustainability,
    n_forward_points_t0     = n_forward_points_t0,
    threshold_percentage_t0 = threshold_percentage_t0,
    slope_threshold_tc      = slope_threshold_tc,
    tc_min_time             = tc_min_time,
    n_forward_points_ti     = n_forward_points_ti,
    threshold_percentage_ti = threshold_percentage_ti,
    min_lysis_time          = min_lysis_time,
    min_increase_threshold  = min_increase_threshold
  )
  
  tc_hours           <- susi_results$tc_hours
  effective_end_time <- susi_results$effective_end_time
  
  cat(sprintf("tc: %.2f h, effective_end_time: %.2f h\n\n",
              tc_hours, effective_end_time))
  
  # ===================================================================
  # STEP 2: Load raw data
  # ===================================================================
  cat("Loading raw OD data...\n")
  
  od_data        <- read.xlsx(file_path, sheet = r_sheet)
  sample_mapping <- read.xlsx(file_path, sheet = name_sheet)
  time_hours     <- od_data$Time / 3600
  
  well_to_sample <- setNames(sample_mapping$sample, sample_mapping$num)
  well_to_sample <- well_to_sample[!is.na(well_to_sample)]
  
  # ===================================================================
  # STEP 3: Analyze each MOI
  # ===================================================================
  moi_samples <- c("10^-5", "10^-4", "10^-3", "10^-2", "10^-1", "10^0")
  
  all_diagnostics <- list()
  all_summaries   <- list()
  all_plots       <- list()
  
  for (moi in moi_samples) {
    cat(sprintf("\nAnalyzing MOI %s...\n", moi))
    
    if (!moi %in% names(susi_results$resistance_data)) {
      cat(sprintf("  MOI %s not found - skipping\n", moi))
      next
    }
    
    well_results  <- susi_results$resistance_data[[moi]]$well_results
    
    moi_wells_all <- names(well_to_sample)[well_to_sample == moi]
    moi_wells_all <- moi_wells_all[moi_wells_all %in% names(od_data)]
    
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build per-well diagnostic data
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    diagnostic_data <- data.frame()
    
    for (well_name in moi_wells_all) {
      col_match <- regexpr("[0-9]+", well_name)
      if (col_match > 0) {
        col_num <- as.numeric(regmatches(well_name, col_match))
        if      (col_num >= 1  && col_num <= 12) { bio_rep <- 1
        } else if (col_num >= 13 && col_num <= 24) { bio_rep <- 2
        } else if (col_num >= 25 && col_num <= 36) { bio_rep <- 3
        } else { bio_rep <- NA }
      } else {
        bio_rep <- NA
      }
      
      has_results <- well_name %in% names(well_results)
      
      if (has_results) {
        well_data    <- well_results[[well_name]]
        t0_detected  <- !is.null(well_data$t0_detected) && well_data$t0_detected
        t0_monotonic <- !is.null(well_data$t0_monotonic) && well_data$t0_monotonic
        ti_detected  <- !is.null(well_data$ti_detected)  && well_data$ti_detected
        t0_value     <- well_data$t0
        ti_value     <- well_data$ti
        susi_value   <- well_data$susi
        
        detection_status <- if (!is.na(susi_value)) {
          if (ti_detected) {
            if (t0_monotonic) "t0_monotonic" else "t0_peak"
          } else {
            "ti_not_detected"
          }
        } else {
          if (!t0_detected && !t0_monotonic) "t0_failed" else "calc_failed"
        }
        
      } else {
        t0_detected      <- FALSE
        t0_monotonic     <- FALSE
        ti_detected      <- FALSE
        t0_value         <- NA
        ti_value         <- NA
        susi_value       <- NA
        detection_status <- "no_results"
      }
      
      od_available <- well_name %in% names(od_data)
      if (od_available) {
        well_od    <- od_data[[well_name]]
        n_valid_od <- sum(!is.na(well_od) & is.finite(well_od))
        all_na     <- all(is.na(well_od))
      } else {
        n_valid_od <- 0
        all_na     <- TRUE
      }
      
      diagnostic_data <- rbind(diagnostic_data, data.frame(
        MOI              = moi,
        Well             = well_name,
        Bio_Rep          = bio_rep,
        Has_Results      = has_results,
        OD_Available     = od_available,
        N_Valid_OD       = n_valid_od,
        All_NA           = all_na,
        t0_Detected      = t0_detected,
        t0_Monotonic     = t0_monotonic,
        ti_Detected      = ti_detected,
        t0_Value         = t0_value,
        ti_Value         = ti_value,
        SusI_Value       = susi_value,
        Detection_Status = detection_status,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    }
    
    # Summary for this MOI
    summary_data <- data.frame(
      MOI              = moi,
      Total_Wells      = nrow(diagnostic_data),
      Bio1_Wells       = sum(diagnostic_data$Bio_Rep == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      Bio2_Wells       = sum(diagnostic_data$Bio_Rep == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
      Bio3_Wells       = sum(diagnostic_data$Bio_Rep == 3, na.rm = TRUE),
      OD_Available     = sum(diagnostic_data$OD_Available),
      Has_Results      = sum(diagnostic_data$Has_Results),
      t0_Peak          = sum(diagnostic_data$Detection_Status == "t0_peak"),
      t0_Monotonic     = sum(diagnostic_data$Detection_Status == "t0_monotonic"),
      t0_Failed        = sum(diagnostic_data$Detection_Status == "t0_failed"),
      ti_Detected      = sum(diagnostic_data$ti_Detected, na.rm = TRUE),
      ti_NotDetected   = sum(diagnostic_data$Detection_Status == "ti_not_detected"),
      SusI_Calculated  = sum(!is.na(diagnostic_data$SusI_Value)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    all_diagnostics[[moi]] <- diagnostic_data
    all_summaries[[moi]]   <- summary_data
    
    cat(sprintf(
      "  Total: %d | t0_peak: %d | t0_mono: %d | t0_fail: %d | ti_detected: %d | ti_endpoint: %d | SusI: %d\n",
      nrow(diagnostic_data),
      summary_data$t0_Peak,
      summary_data$t0_Monotonic,
      summary_data$t0_Failed,
      summary_data$ti_Detected,
      summary_data$ti_NotDetected,
      summary_data$SusI_Calculated))
    
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # OD curve plot per MOI (faceted by Bio_Rep)
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    if (plot_od_curves && nrow(diagnostic_data) > 0) {
      plot_data_list <- list()
      
      for (well_name in diagnostic_data$Well) {
        if (!diagnostic_data$OD_Available[diagnostic_data$Well == well_name]) next
        
        well_od          <- od_data[[well_name]]
        bio_rep          <- diagnostic_data$Bio_Rep[diagnostic_data$Well == well_name]
        detection_status <- diagnostic_data$Detection_Status[diagnostic_data$Well == well_name]
        
        plot_data_list[[well_name]] <- data.frame(
          Time_hours       = time_hours,
          OD               = well_od,
          Well             = well_name,
          Bio_Rep          = bio_rep,
          Detection_Status = detection_status,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
      
      plot_data <- do.call(rbind, plot_data_list)
      
      status_colors <- c(
        "t0_peak"         = "#2E7D32",
        "t0_monotonic"    = "#00897B",
        "ti_not_detected" = "#F57C00",
        "t0_failed"       = "#D32F2F",
        "calc_failed"     = "#C2185B",
        "no_results"      = "#7B1FA2"
      )
      
      status_labels <- c(
        "t0_peak"         = "t0 peak + ti detected",
        "t0_monotonic"    = "t0 monotonic + ti detected",
        "ti_not_detected" = "ti not detected (endpoint used)",
        "t0_failed"       = "t0 detection failed",
        "calc_failed"     = "SusI calculation failed",
        "no_results"      = "no results generated"
      )
      
      present_statuses <- unique(plot_data$Detection_Status)
      used_colors      <- status_colors[names(status_colors) %in% present_statuses]
      used_labels      <- status_labels[names(status_labels) %in% present_statuses]
      
      p <- ggplot(plot_data,
                  aes(x = Time_hours, y = OD,
                      group = Well, color = Detection_Status)) +
        geom_line(alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.6) +
        facet_wrap(~ Bio_Rep, ncol = 1,
                   labeller = labeller(
                     Bio_Rep = function(x) paste("Bio_Rep:", x))) +
        scale_color_manual(
          name   = "Detection Status",
          values = used_colors,
          labels = used_labels
        ) +
        labs(
          title    = paste("OD Curves:", phage_name, "-", moi),
          subtitle = sprintf(
            "tc=%.1fh | t0_peak: %d | t0_mono: %d | t0_fail: %d | ti_detected: %d | ti_endpoint: %d | SusI: %d/%d",
            tc_hours,
            summary_data$t0_Peak,
            summary_data$t0_Monotonic,
            summary_data$t0_Failed,
            summary_data$ti_Detected,
            summary_data$ti_NotDetected,
            summary_data$SusI_Calculated,
            summary_data$Total_Wells
          ),
          x = "Time [h]",
          y = "OD (600 nm)"
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(
          plot.title       = if (show_title) element_text(size = title_size, face = "bold") else element_blank(),
          plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = subtitle_size),
          axis.title       = element_text(size = axis_title_size),
          axis.text        = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
          strip.text       = element_text(size = strip_text_size, face = "bold"),
          legend.text      = element_text(size = legend_text_size),
          legend.title     = element_text(size = legend_title_size),
          legend.position  = if (show_legend) "bottom" else "none"
        )
      
      if (show_timepoint_lines) {
        # tc (red dashed)
        p <- p +
          geom_vline(xintercept = tc_hours,
                     linetype  = "dashed",
                     color     = "#D32F2F",
                     linewidth = 1.2,
                     alpha     = 0.8) +
          annotate("text",
                   x     = tc_hours + 0.5,
                   y     = max(plot_data$OD, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.95,
                   label = "tc",
                   color = "#D32F2F",
                   size  = tc_label_size,
                   hjust = 0)
        
        # t0 lines (blue solid)
        t0_values <- unique(diagnostic_data$t0_Value[
          !is.na(diagnostic_data$t0_Value)])
        if (length(t0_values) > 0) {
          for (t0_val in t0_values) {
            p <- p +
              geom_vline(xintercept = t0_val,
                         linetype  = "solid",
                         color     = "#1976D2",
                         linewidth = 0.8,
                         alpha     = 0.3)
          }
          p <- p +
            annotate("text",
                     x     = min(t0_values) - 0.3,
                     y     = max(plot_data$OD, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.90,
                     label = "t0",
                     color = "#1976D2",
                     size  = timepoint_label_size,
                     hjust = 1)
        }
        
        # ti lines (green dotted) — only actually detected ti
        ti_values <- unique(diagnostic_data$ti_Value[
          diagnostic_data$ti_Detected & !is.na(diagnostic_data$ti_Value)])
        if (length(ti_values) > 0) {
          for (ti_val in ti_values) {
            p <- p +
              geom_vline(xintercept = ti_val,
                         linetype  = "dotted",
                         color     = "#388E3C",
                         linewidth = 0.8,
                         alpha     = 0.3)
          }
          p <- p +
            annotate("text",
                     x     = mean(ti_values),
                     y     = max(plot_data$OD, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.85,
                     label = "ti",
                     color = "#388E3C",
                     size  = timepoint_label_size,
                     hjust = 0.5)
        }
      }
      
      all_plots[[moi]] <- p
      print(p)
    }
  }
  
  # ===================================================================
  # STEP 4: Save to Excel
  # ===================================================================
  cat(sprintf("\nSaving results to %s...\n", output_excel))
  
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  
  addWorksheet(wb, "Summary")
  summary_combined <- do.call(rbind, all_summaries)
  writeData(wb, "Summary", summary_combined)
  
  # Parameters sheet (tc_min_time を追加)
  addWorksheet(wb, "Parameters")
  params_df <- data.frame(
    Parameter = c("t0_min_time", "t0_sustainability",
                  "n_forward_points_t0", "threshold_percentage_t0",
                  "slope_threshold_tc", "tc_min_time",
                  "n_forward_points_ti", "threshold_percentage_ti",
                  "min_increase_threshold", "time_limit_hours", "tc_hours"),
    Value = c(t0_min_time, t0_sustainability,
              n_forward_points_t0, threshold_percentage_t0,
              slope_threshold_tc, tc_min_time,
              n_forward_points_ti, threshold_percentage_ti,
              min_increase_threshold,
              ifelse(is.null(time_limit_hours), NA, time_limit_hours),
              tc_hours)
  )
  writeData(wb, "Parameters", params_df)
  
  for (moi in names(all_diagnostics)) {
    sheet_name <- gsub("\\^", "", moi)
    addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
    writeData(wb, sheet_name, all_diagnostics[[moi]])
  }
  
  all_non_success <- do.call(rbind, lapply(all_diagnostics, function(df) {
    df[df$Detection_Status != "t0_peak" &
       df$Detection_Status != "t0_monotonic", ]
  }))
  
  if (!is.null(all_non_success) && nrow(all_non_success) > 0) {
    addWorksheet(wb, "Non_Success")
    writeData(wb, "Non_Success", all_non_success)
  }
  
  saveWorkbook(wb, output_excel, overwrite = TRUE)
  cat("Excel file saved!\n")
  
  cat("\n=== OVERALL SUMMARY ===\n")
  print(summary_combined)
  
  cat("\n=== DIAGNOSIS COMPLETE ===\n\n")
  
  return(invisible(list(
    diagnostics  = all_diagnostics,
    summaries    = summary_combined,
    plots        = all_plots,
    susi_results = susi_results
  )))
}
```

## Quick start: diagnose_all_mois_enhanced()

```{r}
phage_name <- "T1"
file_path  <- build_file_path(phage_name)

diagnosis <- diagnose_all_mois_enhanced(
  file_path                = file_path,
  phage_name                = phage_name,
  n_forward_points_t0       = 10,
  n_forward_points_ti       = 7,
  threshold_percentage_t0   = 0.6,
  threshold_percentage_ti   = 0.6,
  min_increase_threshold    = 0.008,
  t0_sustainability         = 20,
  time_limit_hours          = 24,
  output_excel              = paste0(phage_name, "_diagnosis.xlsx")
)

# Example: loosen the t0 threshold and compare how many wells get a valid SusI
diagnosis_loose <- diagnose_all_mois_enhanced(
  file_path                 = file_path,
  phage_name                 = phage_name,
  threshold_percentage_t0    = 0.5,
  output_excel               = paste0(phage_name, "_diagnosis_t0_50pct.xlsx")
)

cat("Default  (60%):", sum(diagnosis$summaries$SusI_Calculated), "wells\n")
cat("Loosened (50%):", sum(diagnosis_loose$summaries$SusI_Calculated), "wells\n")
```


<!-- グラフの色の意味 -->
<!-- 緑 (success)    SusI計算成功 -->
<!-- 赤 (t0_detection_failed)    t0検出失敗 -->
<!-- オレンジ (ti_detection_failed)    ti検出失敗（まだ未実装） -->
<!-- 紫 (susi_calculation_failed)    その他の計算失敗 -->
<!-- 深紫 (no_results_generated)   結果が全く生成されていない -->

<!-- 列名意味 -->
<!-- MOI   対象MOI条件  -->
<!-- Total_Wells   このMOIに割り当てられた全well数（通常36） -->
<!-- Bio1_WellsBio Rep 1のwell数（通常12） -->
<!-- Bio2_WellsBio Rep 2のwell数（通常12） -->
<!-- Bio3_WellsBio Rep 3のwell数（通常12） -->
<!-- OD_Available    ODデータが存在するwell数 -->
<!-- Has_Results   計算結果が生成されたwell数（全NAでないwell） -->
<!-- t0_Peak   ピーク検出でt0が見つかったwell数 -->
<!-- t0_Monotonic    単調減少検出でt0が見つかったwell数（初期点=t0） -->
<!-- t0_Failedt0   検出が完全に失敗したwell数 -->
<!-- ti_Detected   tiが実際に検出されたwell数 -->
<!-- ti_NotDetected    tiが検出されず、観測最終時刻に設定されたwell数 -->
<!-- SusI_Calculated   SusIが正常に計算できたwell数 -->
